newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIAN O/N RATES SEEN STABLE, LAT EASES AGAINST DOLLAR.
newsitem.headline: LATVIAN O/N RATES SEEN STABLE, LAT EASES AGAINST DOLLAR.

text.p: Overnight rates in Latvia were seen stabilising after edging up in the morning and the lat eased a bit against the dollar as big companies finished paying their monthly taxes, dealers said on Tuesday.
Overnight rates inched up to around to 3.40/4.40, 3.50 percent/4.450 percent from 3.20/4.20 percent in the morning and dealers expected them to stabilise.
"The liquidity situation in the banking sector doesn't suggest at the moment that the rates will move much either way," said one dealer.
"After the central bank's clearing results are finished at 1200, it will be more clear what banks need to borrow and how much," he added.
In the forex markets, the lat eased off a bit against the dollar to 0.5695-0.5700 from 0.5680-85 on Monday. The central bank's intervention rate late on Tuesday morning was 0.5690.
Demand for lats was high last week as banks bid for a one-year, 12 million lat T-bill issue and big companies paid their monthly taxes.
Demand has fallen off since and dealers said they did not anticipate it to pick up this week.
"Overall, things are pretty quiet on the foreign exchange markets right now...only a couple of million lats or so per day," said one dealer.
